forces: palmate/lobed — kit mileage (shared maple parts); red through-season theme
descriptor: Oval maple, red in every season; 3–5 lobed toothed leaves with red petioles; fire-engine-red fall; grey vertically-ridged bark.
identityNotes: V-shaped (sharp/angular) sinuses, serrated/toothed margins, and red twigs/petioles separate it from sugar maple. The most reliable bright-red fall of the three maples; red recurs in twigs, early flowers, fruit, and fall.

referenceImages.caption: Rounded-oval crown; 3–5 lobed toothed leaves with red petioles.
Brilliant red autumn foliage, the species' signature.
Grey bark, smooth on young trees becoming vertically ridged/striped.

leaf.silhouette.note: palmate↔lobed near; red maple is shallowly palmate-lobed — palmate pack is workable

leaf.face.note: whitish/glaucous underside, less silver than silver maple

overlay.type.note: showy small red flowers very early; red paired samaras late spring

leaf.note: kit-mileage: shares the palmate pack; smaller card
